name: @activepieces/piece-autocalls
description: Automate phone calls using our AI calling platform.

auth.description: Create an API key in your Autocalls account and paste the value here. Get API key here -> https://app.autocalls.ai.

addLead.name: addLead
addLead.description: Add lead to an outbound campaign, to be called by an assistant from our platform.

phone_number.description: Enter the phone number of the customer

variables.description: Variables to pass to the assistant

allow_dupplicate.description: Allow the same phone number to be added to the campaign more than once

num_secondary_contacts.description: How many secondary contacts do you want to add?

secondary_contacts.description: Add secondary contacts for this lead. Each contact can have its own phone number and variables.

aiMetadata.description: Enrolls a lead (phone number plus template variables, optionally with secondary contacts) into an Autocalls outbound campaign so its assistant will dial them. Use to queue contacts for a campaign rather than placing a one-off call. Requires a campaign id and phone number; creates a new lead each call (unless duplicates are disallowed), so it is not idempotent.

sendSms.name: sendSms
sendSms.description: Send an SMS to a customer using a phone number from our platform.

from.description: Select an SMS capable phone number to send the SMS from

to.description: Enter the phone number of the customer

body.description: Enter the text message to send to the customer (max 300 characters)

aiMetadata.description: Sends a single SMS text message to a customer phone number from a selected SMS-capable Autocalls phone number. Use to deliver an outbound text rather than place a call. Requires a sender phone number id, recipient number, and message body (max 300 characters); each call sends a new message, so it is not idempotent.

campaignControl.name: campaignControl
campaignControl.description: Start or stop an outbound campaign from our platform.

action.description: Select action to perform on the campaign

aiMetadata.description: Sets the run status of an Autocalls outbound campaign, choosing one of two modes via the action input: start (begin dialing leads) or stop (halt dialing). Use to control whether a campaign is actively calling. Requires a campaign id; idempotent since repeating the same start/stop request leaves the campaign in the same state.

makePhoneCall.name: makePhoneCall
makePhoneCall.description: Call a customer by it's phone number using an assistant from our platform.

phone_number.description: Enter the phone number of the customer

variables.description: Variables to pass to the assistant

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound AI phone call to a single customer phone number using a selected Autocalls outbound assistant, passing template variables (e.g. customer_name) into the conversation. Use to dial one contact on demand rather than enrolling them in a campaign. Requires a valid outbound assistant id and a phone number; each call dials again, so it is not idempotent.

deleteLead.name: deleteLead
deleteLead.description: Delete a lead from a campaign.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently removes a single lead from its Autocalls campaign by lead id, identified by phone number and campaign name. Use to drop a contact so it is no longer dialed. Requires the lead id; not idempotent since the lead no longer exists after the first successful delete.

phoneCallEnded.name: phoneCallEnded
phoneCallEnded.description: Triggers when a phone call ends, with extracted variables.

aiMetadata.description: Fires via webhook when a call handled by the selected Autocalls assistant ends, delivering the call outcome including duration, status, the input and extracted variables, and the full transcript.

extracted_variables.summary: Call ended without clear objective being met.

transcript.text: Im doing well, thank you for asking.
How can I assist you today?

getAssistants.name: getAssistants
getAssistants.description: Triggers when assistants are fetched or updated in your Autocalls account.

start.description: Filter assistants created after this date. Example: 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z

end.description: Filter assistants created before this date. Example: 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z

aiMetadata.description: Polls the Autocalls account and fires for each assistant created or updated since the last check, optionally bounded by start and end date filters. Represents a new or changed assistant record.

sampleData.name: Customer Support Assistant
sampleData.description: Handles customer inquiries and support requests

inboundCall.name: inboundCall
inboundCall.description: Triggers for variables before connecting an inbound call.

aiMetadata.description: Fires via webhook when an inbound call reaches the selected Autocalls assistant, before the call is connected, providing the caller and assistant phone numbers so the flow can supply variables for the conversation.
